rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Three-level completeness.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Strategy frame = this beat's own backing stance (L40, "a handoff prompt authored from the student's own session evidence is a candidate, not a plan") plus the prompt registry's own `produces` field (agents-that-build-agents-handoff.md frontmatter: "scans the work, picks one skill with the student and builds it, then puts efficient checks on the work that skill produces") — matches L5's body framing ("one skill, with its checks") exactly. Runtime artifact = the scrollback return from the L7 fence. Sendable customer asset = the saved handoff prompt (L9), and the registry prompt's own body instructs it to be self-sufficient ("name the shapes inside the prompt and tell it what to re-read," since "the fresh session will not have this context"). Within this file's own artifact chain the three levels read backward cleanly. (Out of this judge's lane, noted separately: the PARENT module's own artefact-contracts prose in spot-gaps-build-the-loop.md still describes a multi-skill "skill per recurring shape" deliverable that no longer matches this lecture's single-skill framing — flagged in notes for cross_module, since "artefact contracts" is explicitly named as that judge's surface.)
